title: Grateful Dead Live at RFK Stadium on 1973-06-10
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD D

ai_review.summary: A stellar 1973 soundboard capture with a soaring Dark Star, epic Morning Dew and other classics, paired with an excellent Charlie Miller transfer.
ai_review.review: This three‑set monster from June 10 1973 showcases the band at peak improvisational height – highlights include a monumental Dark Star (especially its final third), a transcendent Morning Dew, and superb performances of Bird Song, Jack Straw, Box of Rain and The Eyes of the World.  Charlie Miller’s soundboard transfer is praised as crisp and immersive, making the recording virtually as vivid as being in the audience.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen overwhelmingly positive reviews (13 × 5★, 1 × 4★) praise both musical performance and the soundboard transfer; minor quibbles are limited to one odd Phil moment, so the combined show‑and‑recording rating is near perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller’s transfer described as crisp, clear and immersive; no significant dropouts or balance issues reported.

poor_songs: Round and Round and Johnny Be Good
show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑hour marathon with a tight first set, an expansive second set of deep jams (notably Dark Star and Bird Song), and a high‑energy third set that closed with fireworks during Playin' in the Band.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for patient, restrained Not Fade solo and classic Chuck Berry‑style guitar work; overall guitar tone described as perfect.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass highlighted on Box of Rain and Bird Song; one reviewer notes a weird, awkward cue attempt by Phil during Dark Star.
